label: common_2130_announce_01
text: Finally, only four Trainers remain! Time for our\ncontestants to face their third matches, everyone!

label: common_2130_announce_02
text: The matchup for this battle will be Champion\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)] versus...

label: common_2130_battle_02
text: This “School Battle Brawl” is for deciding the\nstrongest Trainer in the academy, right?\c\nMan, I’m so pumped up!!![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: common_2130_battle_03
text: There’s no better place for me to show off\nmy strengths![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: common_2130_battle_04
text: And I hear you’re the reason we’re having this\ntournament? You have my thanks for that![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: common_2130_battle_06
text: As a teacher, I feel like it’s my duty to lead my\nstudents to success.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: common_2130_battle_07
text: BUT! Since I AM the battle studies teacher here,\nI can’t very well lose in a battle, can I?![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: common_2130_battle_08
text: So don’t expect me to go easy on you! I’m going\nto give it all I’ve got![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: common_2130_announce_04
text: And the winner of this third-round battle is...\nChampion [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!

label: common_2130_battle_10
text: But I still got something great out of this battle!\nThis was a massive chance for me to grow![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: common_2130_battle_11
text: You may be surprised to hear this, but we adults\nare still learning every day, too.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: common_2130_battle_12
text: That’s why we’re always harping on you kids to\nstudy! Turns out we actually DO know what we’re\r\ntalking about![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: common_2130_battle_13
text: Thanks for the battle! Keep aiming for the top in\nthis tournament, and don’t forget...\r\nOsu! Osu! Osu![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
